description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the OpenClaw 7-principle, 21-dimension framework. (2) Read the NexusMFG spec at docs/architecture/nexusmfg_spec_v2.3.md. (3) Produce nexusmfg_analysis.md structured around all 7 principles (with emoji markers 1️⃣–7️⃣) and all 21 sub-dimensions by their exact Chinese names. Critical proprietary traps: (a) Principle 7 has only 2 sub-dimensions (自进化Agent + 人机共生进化), not 3 — agents that assume a uniform 3-per-principle pattern will fabricate a third and fail. (b) The agent must correctly identify specific gaps from the spec: TPM chips exist but SDK is unexposed (硬件级信任链 = partial), memory distillation is absent (存储瓶颈), skill inheritance is unsupported (只能复制粘贴), and edge self-organization requires manual configuration. A generic architecture review without the exact OpenClaw structure and framework-specific verdicts will fail the critical checks.
